papers.title: Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithms
papers.authors: Geetika, Shivani Singh Chauhan, Gauranshi Gupta, Anant Jain, Kaushik Kalyanaraman, Bapi Chatterjee
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi, India; Department of Mathematics, Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi, India
papers.abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. The key idea is to use stale (purely) stochastic gradient noise for adversarial perturbations. Theoretically, we show that SOMA's sample complexity is invariant to the perturbation direction. We provide explorations and insights into SOMA's robustness to heavy-tailed gradient noise. We extensively explore SOMA's efficacy in (a) mitigating quality degradation due to post-training quantization, and (b) catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning of LLMs.
papers.summary_cn: 针对锐度感知最小化与Muon优化器结合的研究空白，以及传统SAM每步需额外梯度计算、在大模型上代价过高的问题，提出SOMA算法：利用过期的纯随机梯度噪声构造对抗扰动，无需额外梯度开销。理论上证明其样本复杂度不随扰动方向改变，并分析了其在重尾梯度噪声下的鲁棒性。实验验证了SOMA在缓解训练后量化导致的性能下降和微调中的灾难性遗忘两方面的有效性。

papers.title: Measuring the Energy Cost of Completing Tasks with Quantized Language-Model Agents
papers.authors: Stephen Abkin, Aldric Yang, Alex Flesher, Nitheesh Kodarapu, Deepak Panigrahy, Aakash Tyagi, David Kebo Houngninou
papers.affiliations: Texas A&M University
papers.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and energy needed to serve large language models (LLMs) and AI agents for coding and data analysis can now run on locally hosted LLMs. In practice, this benefit is commonly benchmarked per output token. Yet an agent calls its model repeatedly, runs tools, and revises its work, and quantization can change both how much the agent generates and whether it succeeds. Existing energy studies either compare quantized models on single requests or measure agents at one fixed precision, overlooking how a change in precision plays out across a complete agent task.   To address this gap, this paper presents the first characterization of the task-level energy trade-offs of model quantization in locally hosted agents. We develop 29 agent tasks with automatic pass/fail checks in six families, ranging from single-answer SQL analytics to multi-step repository bug fixing, and measure CPU and GPU energy per output token and per completed task for 4-bit and 8-bit versions of two open-weight models on bare-metal NVIDIA A100 nodes with llama.cpp.   Our findings reveal that 4-bit precision generally saves energy per token, though whether it saves energy per completed task is task dependent and changes with the model and the execution budget (i.e., limits on turns, tokens, and time). We trace this discrepancy to the extra tokens needed to complete a task in full, which translates into using up to 3.5 times as much energy per completed task. These findings offer actionable guidance for developers and operators choosing model precision for agents, showing how tokens per completed task, set against the per-token saving, reveal whether lower precision completes the work with less energy.
papers.summary_cn: 针对量化大语言模型智能体的能耗评估多停留在单请求或单token层面、忽视完整任务开销的问题，提出首个面向本地部署智能体的任务级能耗对比研究。构建六类共29个带自动判分的任务，在NVIDIA A100裸机上用llama.cpp测量Qwen3-30B-A3B的4比特与8比特版本在每token和每完成任务上的CPU与GPU能耗。结果表明4比特通常降低单token能耗，但任务级能耗取决于任务、模型与执行预算，因额外生成token，能耗最多可增至3.5倍，为精度选择提供依据。

papers.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
papers.authors: David Jin, Beshr IslamBouli, Tarushii Goel, Han Guo, Yoon Kim
papers.affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.
papers.summary_cn: 针对FP4后训练量化在Blackwell GPU上仍存在精度损失的问题，提出BiLoCo：将低秩修正的左右因子存储为{±1}二值符号向量而非BF16数，使每个秩一分量的存储减少16倍，且修正变为加减运算，可在CUDA核心上与张量核心的FP4 GEMM并发执行。方法通过逐分量交替优化拟合符号向量并对缩放系数联合最小二乘求解。在4B–72B模型上，相同存储预算下秩512二值修正可解释权重Frobenius范数的47–53%（BF16秩32仅26–29%），困惑度相当或更优；融合内核在批大小为1时仅比纯FP4 GEMM慢至多11%。

papers.title: Training an MoE LLM in MXFP4: How We Closed the Gap to BF16
papers.authors: Han Wang, Zhitao Wang, Natalia Frumkin, Xuanwu Yin, Alireza Khodamoradi, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum
papers.affiliations: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) in sub-8-bit arithmetic promises substantial gains in memory bandwidth and compute throughput, yet FP4 formats introduce quantization error severe enough to destabilize optimization if left unaddressed. We present ALTO, an open-source training recipe for GPT-OSS-20B, a 20-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on the MLPerf Small MoE Training benchmark under the MXFP4 microscaling format. The recipe combines established techniques from Abecassis, Felix et al. [arXiv:2509.25149] (hybrid 1D/2D block quantization, randomized Hadamard transforms, and stochastic rounding) with a simplified weight de-oscillation scheme adapted from TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]. On C4 validation at global batch size 16, MXFP4 + RHT + SR + de-oscillation reaches a validation loss of 3.3350 at 16,128 steps, only 0.007 above the BF16 baseline (3.3283), closing roughly 50% of the gap left by MXFP4 without de-oscillation (3.3418). Measured by steps to reach the MLPerf quality target (validation loss 3.34), de-oscillation cuts the FP4 convergence overhead relative to BF16 from +20.0% to +5.0%. We also report negative end-to-end results from differential gradient estimation, outlier clipping, and macro-block scaling, despite each showing operator-level SNR gains. All experiments use simulated MXFP4 kernels on AMD MI300 hardware and wall-clock speed has not been optimized.
papers.summary_cn: 针对FP4低精度训练中量化误差大、权重振荡导致优化不稳定的问题，提出开源训练方案ALTO，在MLPerf Small MoE基准上以MXFP4格式训练200亿参数MoE模型GPT-OSS-20B。方法结合混合1D/2D块量化、随机Hadamard变换、随机舍入与简化的权重去振荡机制。在C4验证集上，验证损失达3.3350，仅比BF16基线3.3283高0.007，收敛开销从+20.0%降至+5.0%，基本弥合与BF16的差距。

papers.title: MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization
papers.authors: Yanshuo Chen, Chenxi Liu, Reza Shirkavand, Heng Huang
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, University of Maryland, College Park
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a key technique for efficiently deploying large language models, as it compresses weights into low-bit representations without retraining. Existing PTQ solvers, including GPTQ, LDLQ, and block coordinate descent, commit each weight block to a single codeword before its neighbors are considered, leaving near-optimal alternatives unexplored. In this work, we cast row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, in which existing solvers correspond to a zero-temperature, hard-decision limit retaining only the top codeword per block. We propose Message-Passing Quantization (MPQ), which preserves soft posterior information across blocks during inference and commits to hard codewords only at the output stage. MPQ first uses vector approximate message passing to compute approximate blockwise posteriors, then refines a hard-decision initialization by exact block coordinate descent. Across 2-bit lattice and 3- and 4-bit scalar quantization on dense language models from Llama, Qwen, and Mistral families, MPQ improves perplexity and zero-shot accuracy over strong hard-decision baselines, and composes favorably with preprocessing techniques such as activation-aware scaling and incoherence processing. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/MPQ.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型训练后量化中GPTQ、LDLQ等求解器过早对每个权重块做硬码字分配、忽略近优候选的问题，将逐行量化建模为离散码本上的后验推断，指出现有方法相当于零温度硬判决极限，并提出消息传递量化MPQ：先用有限温度的向量近似消息传递保留跨块的软后验信息，再以精确块坐标下降细化硬判决结果。在Llama、Qwen、Mistral模型上的2比特格点及3、4比特标量量化实验中，MPQ在困惑度和零样本准确率上均优于强基线，低比特场景提升最大，并与激活感知缩放等预处理技术良好兼容。

papers.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
papers.authors: Ammar Ali, Stamatis Lefkimmiatis
papers.affiliations: LEAD Lab, ITMO University
papers.abstract: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. And choosing the decisions is the ground-state problem of a higher-order Boltzmann machine whose interactions follow the paths of the tree, the problem class that annealers and quantum optimizers are built to solve. Today these questions are handled apart: each compression method brings its own format and solver, a circuit with fixed weights needs a dedicated constant multiplier for every weight, and discrete solvers reach only narrow subproblems such as rounding. Weight formats have long been moving toward shared decisions, through group scales, shared exponents, microexponents and sparse weights; TWIG takes this trend to its end, and every common format is a shallow TWIG at no extra cost. On five weight matrices of a large language model, a flat tree whose signed power-of-two terms are chosen per weight for circuit cost, with no group scales, needs 9--15\% fewer additions than GPTQ at equal layer error at 3- and 4-bit accuracy on typical matrices, and 20--55\% fewer on matrices with strong outliers.
papers.summary_cn: 针对神经网络权重压缩方法各自为政、缺乏统一表示的问题，提出TWIG表示，将每个权重表示为一条由符号、二的幂移位、零门控和共享表索引等离散决策构成的路径，相关权重共享路径上部从而只存储一次，使剪枝、量化、低秩分解、码本和权重共享统一为对同一对象的编辑，并可由高阶玻尔兹曼机求解器优化。在大语言模型五个权重矩阵上，3和4比特精度下加法次数比GPTQ少9–15%，含强异常值矩阵上少20–55%。

papers.title: KiRoSe: Using Kinematic Data for Efficient Segmentation of Robot Demonstrations
papers.authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Richard Cheng, Sergey Zakharov, Ken Goldberg
papers.affiliations: 未找到单位信息
papers.abstract: Segmenting robot demonstration data into disjoint temporal and semantic subsegments is valuable for learning, cleaning, retrieval, and analysis. Segmentation is often performed manually in a tedious and error prone process. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have the potential for automating this process, but directly ingesting raw multi camera video streams into MLLMs can be costly and can quickly exhaust context windows. In this paper, we introduce KiRoSe (Kinematics for Robot Segmentation), a novel framework that focuses on the companion stream of robot kinematic data. Inspired by the principle of classical entropy coding, such as Huffman coding, where frequently occurring symbols are represented more compactly, we propose Sparse Motion Tokens (SMTs), a discrete kinematic vocabulary designed to compactly represent recurring, temporally localized motion patterns, which we refer to as kinematic events. SMTs are learned by encoding kinematic trajectories with temporal segment supervision and quantizing the resulting features. We use increasingly available robot demonstration subtask annotations to supervise an open language model to interpret the resulting token sequences. Evaluation against human labeled segmentation shows that KiRoSe can substantially outperform baseline segmentation methods in F1 quality and transfers zero shot to unseen robot embodiments and egocentric human motion, while preserving the language models open vocabulary knowledge. Beyond segmentation, KiRoSe tracks task progress on an unseen robot and detects when an action is being reversed.(website: https://berkeleyautomation.github.io/kirose/)
papers.summary_cn: 针对机器人演示数据难以自动切分为时间语义子段、人工标注繁琐且易错的问题，提出KiRoSe框架，不依赖原始多路视频流，而是利用伴随的运动学数据完成分段。借鉴霍夫曼编码中高频符号紧凑表示的思想，设计稀疏运动令牌（SMT），将运动学数据量化为离散词汇，大幅压缩上下文长度后供多模态大语言模型处理，从而降低成本并避免上下文窗口耗尽，实现高效、自动化的演示数据分割。

papers.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.authors: Stephen Chung, Wenyu Du
papers.affiliations: DualverseAI
papers.abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
papers.summary_cn: 针对语言模型中 n-gram 嵌入表占用大量内存的问题（如 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 Engram 内存达 1960 亿参数），提出以低精度存储嵌入值，并系统比较均匀量化、正态分位数量化与 Lloyd–Max 量化等方法及不同位宽分配。实验表明，四位量化表可节省约 75% 的表内存，同时保留超过 99% 的验证损失改善；配合短微调可进一步恢复性能，将节省的内存再投资于更大的表甚至可超越全精度表；在大型现有模型上亦可节省 47–55% 内存且困惑度上升不到 1.2%。

papers.title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
papers.authors: Sebastian Loeschcke, Ivan Koryakovskiy, Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa, Riccardo Del Chiaro, Mart van Baalen, Paul N. Whatmough, Markus Nagel
papers.affiliations: University of Copenhagen; Qualcomm AI Research
papers.abstract: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
papers.summary_cn: 针对低比特大语言模型向量量化感知训练机制缺乏研究的问题，提出SQuAT方法：将权重分解为方向与幅度，方向用E8衍生的球形码本量化、增益用低比特标量量化器独立量化，并对两者分别施加直通估计器，形成隐式的球面优化；同时设计分布式最近邻分配方案，将训练加速12.8倍并扩展到100亿token。在LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B及Qwen3-1.7B上均优于标准方法，2.25比特下取得最优精度。

papers.title: ProQuant: Preserving Expert Quality over Quantity in Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.authors: Jiaqi Chen, Xianglong Yan, Chengzhu Bao, Xie Chen, Yulun Zhang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce computation through sparse activation but still incur substantial storage costs. Mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by quantizing different model components at different bit widths, but existing methods often struggle to preserve generation quality under tight bit budgets. We identify two key challenges: (1) nonlinear quantization errors at extremely low precision are underestimated when cross-layer propagation is ignored; (2) direct router fine-tuning may cause routing drift, and calibration gains may not generalize to downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose ProQuant, a weight-only PTQ framework for MoE models. Prune-or-Prioritize Mixed-Precision Allocation (PoP) jointly optimizes expert pruning and bit-width assignment. It allows higher-precision experts to substitute for severely degraded ones while improving bit-budget utilization. Routing-Consistent RMSNorm Finetune (RoCo) adapts expert input representations through mathematically equivalent transformations. It compensates for quantization errors to reduce routing drift. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProQuant outperforms existing methods across diverse generative tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/ThrowBug/ProQuant.git.
papers.summary_cn: 针对MoE大模型超低比特量化下生成质量下降的问题，提出仅权重量化框架ProQuant：通过PoP联合优化专家剪枝与位宽分配，用高精度专家替代严重退化者以提升比特预算利用率，并以RoCo经数学等价变换调整专家输入表示、在保持路由一致的同时补偿量化误差。在Qwen3-30B-A3B等模型上，平均专家精度1.5、2.0、2.5比特下的多项生成任务均优于现有方法。

papers.title: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
papers.authors: Chenhan Lyu, Kit Wislocki, Sarah Elizabeth Stoeckl, Maitreyi Sinha, Amir Rahmani
papers.affiliations: University of California, Irvine, USA
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.
papers.summary_cn: 针对心理健康聊天机器人安全评估结果难以检查、可解释性差的问题，提出由两位临床医生主导定义和裁定的规则库方案，包含四项安全检查并经过形式化一致性验证，作为大语言模型输出的防护层，每个判定均可由具名规则和16项事实重新计算。与同模型LLM评判器对比显示，该验证层按设计不会误要求已含危机资源的回复（评判器对84.6%的此类回复误加要求），但一次规则修订使边界提示的拦截率从6.0%升至16.0%，代价被如实报告。

papers.title: Model-intrinsic, Weight-level, and Training-free Spectral Fingerprinting for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yanan He, Yanli Chen, Ling Xiong, Gejian Zhao, Hanzhou Wu
papers.affiliations: School of Big Data and Computer Science, Guizhou Normal University; School of Information Science, Beijing Language and Culture University; School of Communication and Information Engineering, Shanghai University
papers.abstract: The increasing release and reuse of Large Language Models (LLMs) as open-weight checkpoints make model fingerprinting important for ownership protection and offline auditing. Existing fingerprinting methods typically construct evidence from query responses, generated outputs, or input-induced activations. Although effective in representation-based settings, they can be affected by prompt selection, decoding configuration, inference environment, and forward-pass implementation, which may limit their applicability. Here we introduce a model-intrinsic weight-level framework that derives compact fingerprints from spectral structures encoded in LLM parameters. Specifically, the framework constructs GATE spectral scalar features from the singular-value distributions of GATE projection weights in gated feed-forward networks (FFNs), and aggregates the resulting layer-wise features through depth-wise segmented pooling to form a model-level fingerprint. Such representation preserves coarse layer-depth organization while reducing dependence on strict layer-to-layer alignment, enabling comparison across LLMs with different depths. The similarity between fingerprints is computed by linear centered kernel alignment. The entire pipeline is training-free and does not require input samples, generated outputs, forward activations, or an auxiliary verifier. Experiments on representative LLM families and post-training variants have demonstrated a clear separation between source-related models and unrelated ones, and stable similarity under instruction tuning, quantization, pruning, and distillation-related modifications, which verify that spectral features are robust evidence for LLM fingerprinting.
papers.summary_cn: 针对开放权重大模型的所有权保护与离线审计问题，提出一种模型内生、权重级、免训练的谱指纹框架：从门控前馈网络中 GATE 投影权重的奇异值分布提取谱标量特征，经深度分段池化聚合为模型级指纹，并用线性中心化核对齐度量相似度。整个流程无需输入样本、生成输出、前向激活或辅助验证器，支持跨层深模型比较。实验表明源相关模型与无关模型明显分离，且在指令微调、量化、剪枝和蒸馏相关修改下指纹相似度保持稳定。

papers.title: Bio-Inspired Auditory Processing: Coupling Parallel Resonate-and-Fire Dynamics with Ternary Recurrent Networks for Speech Recognition
papers.authors: Pavlos Poulos, Katelyn Sadorf, Themos Stafylakis, Costas A. Anastassiou
papers.affiliations: Department of Informatics, Athens University of Economics and Business, Greece; Archimedes AI, Athena Research Center, Greece; California Institute of Technology, USA; Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, USA
papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference through sparse, event-driven computation, yet remain constrained on continuous, context-dependent tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR). A key bottleneck is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron, whose membrane decay erases information across pauses and phonetic boundaries while it must both extract features and retain long-range context. Inspired by cortical separation of nonlinear filtering and somatic integration, we introduce the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU): a ternary-weight gated recurrent unit performs temporal filtering, while downstream Resonate-and-Fire (RF) neurons generate the binary spike stream driving the next block's event pathway. This makes binary event transmission a native training constraint rather than a separate deployment-time activation quantization step; together with ternary weights, learned projections avoid dense floating-point matrix MACs. Trained end-to-end on LibriSpeech-960, Small, Medium, and Large stGRUs reach 8.09%, 7.04%, and $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER on test-clean without an external language model. To our knowledge, these are the first matrix-MAC-free spiking networks without a learned ANN sequence decoder to achieve single-digit WER on LibriSpeech. The architecture also achieves 10.88% test CER on Aishell-1 (9.28% on dev) when trained from scratch. Internally, trained networks develop a depth-graded hierarchy: shallow layers act as fast acoustic filters, while deep layers form slower semantic integrators whose latent representations segregate into part-of-speech manifolds and word-level spike events. Deep-layer firing rates follow lognormal distributions with a sparsity gradient, mirroring hierarchical processing observed in human cortex in vivo. Our biologically grounded architecture combines competitive ASR with favorable modeled compute and memory cost.
papers.summary_cn: 针对脉冲神经网络在语音识别中因LIF神经元膜衰减丢失长程上下文、且依赖密集浮点矩阵乘法的问题，提出stGRU架构：以三值权重门控循环单元进行时序滤波，下游共振发放神经元产生二值脉冲驱动事件通路，使事件传输成为原生训练约束并免除矩阵乘加运算。在LibriSpeech-960上训练，大中小模型测试集词错率达8.09%、7.04%和6.44±0.17%，无需外部语言模型；Aishell-1上字错率10.88%。网络内部呈现深度分层结构，浅层为声学滤波器、深层为语义整合器，发放率呈对数正态分布，与人皮层层级处理相似。

papers.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
papers.authors: Patrick Haller, Filipe Laitenberger, Alan Akbik
papers.affiliations: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
papers.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.
papers.summary_cn: 针对线性注意力语言模型推理时循环状态占用显存、限制并发序列数的问题，提出无需训练的四比特状态量化方法PACE。其核心思路是每隔若干个生成token才对状态做一次舍入（而非逐token），并利用解码缓冲降低累积误差；同时观察到门控delta状态的大值沿通道方向聚集成列，因此按列共享量化尺度，并将保留舍入误差最久的四分之一头保持八比特。在4B至35B四个混合模型上，PACE-4/8以约三分之二的显存达到与八比特DAMP相当的性能，PACE-4在同等显存下优于Q-Mamba，且周期性舍入保留了解码加速。

papers.title: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
papers.authors: Boyuan Zheng, Jing Xiong, Chenwei Wu, Hui Shen, Zesen Zhao, Hei Ting Una Chan, Xueshen Liu, Zhen Zhang, Liyue Shen, Zechun Liu, Z. Morley Mao
papers.affiliations: University of Michigan, Ann Arbor; University of California, Santa Barbara; Meta AI
papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.
papers.summary_cn: 针对低比特量化大模型在长程推理任务中精度恢复差、易超出token预算的问题，指出固定序列蒸馏存在轨迹发散与分布错位两大挑战，提出OnQ流水线：量化学生模型自生成轨迹并在自身前缀上接受全精度教师监督，结合按候选词师生概率比加权的Dynamic KL平衡双向KL，纠正欠预测与过预测。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B的2、3比特下取得九基准最高平均分，2比特时Qwen3-8B平均较最强基线提升10.26分，且响应更短、截断与重复错误更少。

papers.title: Local Inference of LLMs on Long Contexts: A Data Systems Perspective
papers.authors: Mattias Dürrmeier, Alberto Lerner
papers.affiliations: University of Fribourg; Computing Flows GmbH
papers.abstract: Large language models can solve complex problems across a variety of subjects, such as mathematics and coding. For such complex analytical tasks, models with a long context perform better. Serving models with long context is currently mostly done on powerful systems with multiple GPUs, which are too expensive for most users. An alternative is local inference, or serving a model on a user's own machine, which removes per-token costs and rate limits, besides keeping sensitive data private and giving users full control over the models they run. The common understanding, however, is that local LLMs need compression (e.g., quantization) to run on a single GPU. In this paper, we set out to study the limitations that prevent serving long-context models for single users, besides the capacity issue. Rather than characterizing a single model on one GPU, we analyze how different models behave across several GPU generations. This lets us uncover not just individual bottlenecks but broader trends in where inefficiencies arise. Our analysis confirms that, as expected, self-attention dominates the runtime for long-context inference. More unexpectedly, our evaluation reveals that the current structure of self-attention leaves key GPU resources significantly underutilized, and the newest GPU is often the least well served. Many of these findings are fundamentally data management problems, from paging the KV cache to improving cache utilization and synchronization in the GPU, which is why we bring this study to the Data Systems community. To engage this community, we present our findings as a series of experimental observations and formulate recommendations for future work.
papers.summary_cn: 针对单用户本地部署长上下文大模型受限于单卡显存、常被要求量化压缩的问题，从数据系统视角在两种模型系列、三代GPU及长达一百万token的上下文上，对解码阶段的编译内核进行性能剖析。发现自注意力主导运行时间，但GPU资源利用率普遍低下，最新GPU反而利用率最差。研究指出KV缓存分页、缓存利用与同步等数据管理问题是关键瓶颈，并给出优化建议，表明合理利用设备后压缩技术可能不再必要。

papers.title: ACE-Compression: An Ability-Centric Evaluation of Compressed Large Language Models
papers.authors: Jiahui Ning, Liang Chen, Yuchen Liang, Yi Zhang, Fenglei Fan
papers.affiliations: City University of Hong Kong; Tongji University; Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute; Sichuan University
papers.abstract: Model compression makes large language models deployable, but today's evaluation tells an incomplete story. Standard practice measures retained task performance and stops there. This misses a critical fact: compression perturbs the distributed knowledge embedded across billions of weights, and task scores alone cannot reveal which underlying abilities survive and which quietly collapse. To solve this question, we introduce ACE-Compression, an ability-centric evaluation framework. Instead of asking only "does the compressed model still answer correctly?", we ask "which of its core abilities remain intact?" Our framework probes four deployment-facing dimensions: procedural reasoning and constraint execution, knowledge grounding and truthfulness, social cognition and affective understanding, and persona fidelity and stylistic consistency. Across more than 35 compressed checkpoints from six open-weight LLMs-covering quantization and pruning-we find that compression redistributes ability profiles. Coarse, local, and surface-level signals often persist, while fine-grained, long-tail, and context-dependent abilities become fragile. Quantization consistently outperforms pruning in retention, but the practical meaning of that gap depends entirely on which ability an application requires. Based on our findings, deployers can choose compression methods by the ability profile their application needs, not just by a leaderboard average. And algorithm designers gain diagnostic signals to build compression methods that preserve what matters. We believe that ACE-Compression turns compression from a black-box accuracy drop into an interpretable intervention-one we can measure, understand, and ultimately improve.
papers.summary_cn: 针对压缩大模型评估仅看任务分数、无法揭示底层能力损伤的问题，提出以能力为中心的评估框架ACE-Compression，从程序推理与约束执行、知识 grounding 与真实性、社会认知与情感理解、人格保真与风格一致四个维度，对6个开源大模型的35个以上量化与剪枝压缩检查点进行测试。结果显示压缩会重塑能力分布：粗粒度能力多能保留，细粒度、长尾能力易崩溃，量化在能力保持上持续优于剪枝，部署者可按需选择压缩方式。

papers.title: E8-QAT: Efficient 2-Bit Quantization-Aware Training with Implicit Lattice Codebooks
papers.authors: Xinyu Lei, Hong Huang, Jiebin Zhang, Hongyu Li, Jinlong Song, Decheng Wu, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Sujian Li
papers.affiliations: Peking University; City University of Hong Kong; Tencent
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint of large language models, but preserving accuracy with efficient training remains challenging. Scalar quantization encodes weights independently, while explicit-codebook vector quantization introduces costly search during training. We propose E8-QAT, a 2-bit quantization-aware training framework that uses the $E_8$ lattice as an implicit eight-dimensional codebook. It jointly quantizes weight groups through arithmetic projection without storing or searching an explicit codebook during the training forward pass. A 2-bit core encoding and sparse extension preserve the selected lattice points exactly, adding less than 0.1\% to core index storage. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, E8-QAT matches the performance of the full-precision model in terms of the average score across the four tasks. E8-QAT improves over the state-of-the-art baseline by 2.03\% on IFEval and by 1.51\% on LiveCodeBench, under the same data, schedule, and bit width. The 2-bit representation reduces peak memory by 80\% and supports a $4\times$ larger batch. At each representation's largest feasible batch, E8-QAT reaches $1.97\times$ the decoding throughput of BF16.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型低比特量化中精度保持与训练效率难以兼顾的问题，提出E8-QAT量化感知训练框架，以E8格作为隐式八维码本，通过算术投影联合量化权重分组，无需存储和搜索显式码本，将每组计算复杂度降至O(v)；采用2比特核心编码加稀疏扩展精确保存格点，额外存储开销不足0.1%。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，四任务平均分73.93与全精度模型持平，IFEval和LiveCodeBench分别比最优基线提升2.03%和1.51%，峰值显存降低80%，支持4倍批量，解码吞吐达BF16的1.97倍。

papers.title: LIRQuant: An Efficient Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization Method for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Desheng Xu, Hanglin Li, Tianchen Song, Zhiyong Zhao, Kun Zhan
papers.affiliations: Li Auto Inc.
papers.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型低比特量化中激活异常值难处理、全局旋转变换忽视通道敏感度差异的问题，提出敏感度感知的局部隔离旋转量化方法：用噪声加权敏感度指标识别敏感通道，仅对其施加可学习旋转，其余通道使用轻量固定Hadamard变换，降低优化复杂度。在W4A4KV4设置下达到最优精度，可训练参数仅为稠密旋转的25%，LLaMA-3-8B校准仅需25分钟、峰值显存20.3GB，推理实现2.3倍预填充加速和3.5倍显存节省。

papers.title: Do We Need the Largest LLMs for Every Clinical Decision?
papers.authors: Ali H. Lazem, William Teahan
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Bangor University; University of Thi-Qar
papers.abstract: Large clinical language models often require multi-GPU infrastructure, limiting local deployment. We introduce CERTA, a decision-level statistical certificate that determines when a quantized model may substitute for its native BF16 reference and escalates decisions that cannot be certified to it. Across eleven instruction-tuned models, both general-purpose and domain-adapted, from three families (7-72B), we evaluated 2,500 clinical-verification decisions from de-identified patient contexts (2,484 patients), with patient-disjoint calibration and testing. In the higher-power operational analysis, round-to-nearest 8-bit quantization at BF16 storage served 99.8-100% of held-out decisions across all eleven models; formal finite-sample guarantees were assessed separately using the exact split-sample procedure. In the same operational analysis, the class-conditional 4-bit frontier reduced the amortized, BF16-equivalent deployment cost to 25.8% and 27.3% of the BF16 reference for Qwen2.5-72B and HuatuoGPT-o1-72B, respectively, with measured peak memory of 43.0 and 42.7 GB, below the nominal capacity of a single 48 GB accelerator. Deployment on that specific hardware was not directly tested. Under the exact split-sample certificate, which also accounts for configuration selection, these costs were 26.7% and 27.9%. On external disease named-entity benchmarks against human annotations, the frontier-selected NF4 configurations had a mean absolute F1 change of 0.045 on both datasets, with substantial model-specific variation. CERTA converts compression from a fixed precision choice into a risk-controlled deployment policy for this verification task.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大型临床语言模型需多GPU部署、难以本地化运行的问题，提出CERTA决策级统计认证方法，通过校准集学习量化模型决策边距的有限样本阈值，能认证的决策由量化模型处理，否则升级至BF16参考模型。在三个家族11个7-72B模型、2500个临床验证决策上，8位量化认证了99.8-100%的决策，4位方案将72B模型部署成本降至BF16的约26-28%，峰值显存低于48GB单卡容量。

papers.title: What Matters for NVFP4 Training? A Comparative Study of Low-Precision Pretraining Recipes
papers.authors: Anjulie Agrusa, Andrei Panferov, Elizabeth Wei, Keith Wyss, Paul Gibbons, Erik Schultheis, Jinhang Choi, Frank Sun, Tijmen Blankevoort, Dan Alistarh
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA; Institute of Science and Technology Austria; Red Hat AI
papers.abstract: Training large language models directly in 4-bit floating-point (FP) formats promises substantial improvements in throughput and energy efficiency. While some recipe design choices have been validated at scale, many promising approaches remain untested beyond small models and short token horizons, leaving open the question of which trends will hold. We present a systematic comparison of recent NVFP4 recipes at medium model scale, evaluating dense 8B and 30B-A3B MoE models trained for up to 1T tokens, with a focus on which ingredients are necessary for accuracy recovery. We propose a final recipe grounded in the principles behind established stable NVFP4 training at scale, incorporating state-of-the-art techniques such as unbiased gradient estimation with lower quantization error than stochastic rounding. To the best of our knowledge, this is the strongest FP4 training result demonstrated at this scale to date in loss gap to BF16. Through ablation studies, we find that: (i) each technique in the optimized recipe measurably improves loss trajectory, (ii) selective high-precision layers are necessary for recovering accuracy at scale, (iii) not all tensors in the backward pass benefit equally from de-biasing, leaving room to apply complementary error-reduction techniques to the remaining tensors.
papers.summary_cn: 针对4位浮点格式直接预训练大语言模型时精度恢复方法缺乏规模化验证的问题，在中等规模上系统比较现有NVFP4训练方案，评测8B稠密模型和30B-A3B MoE模型、训练量最高达1T tokens，提出融合选择性高精度层、随机Hadamard变换、MS-EDEN无偏梯度估计与Four Over Six缩放的Mosaic NVFP4配方。消融表明各技术均改善损失，相对BF16的损失差距为该规模下已知的最佳FP4结果。

papers.title: Noise-shaped Sampling and Annealing for Scalable On-the-edge Training of Binary and Ternary AI Models
papers.authors: Zihao Chen, Zhili Xiao, Rui-Jie Zhu, Yipeng Wang, Jason Eshraghian, Shantanu Chakrabartty
papers.abstract: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $ΣΔ$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $ΣΔ$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss landscape. We validate the framework on a planted quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) benchmark with a known minimizer; on CIFAR-10, where a $13$M-parameter ternary model comes within $1\%$ of full-precision accuracy; on ImageNet-1k, where a ternary ResNet-18 comes within $0.4\%$ Top-5 accuracy of a ternary baseline; on class-incremental continual learning, where prior-task accuracy is preserved; and on MatMul-free language models up to $2.7$B parameters, where it outperforms a straight-through-estimator baseline under matched continued pre-training. Compared with standard quantization-aware training, $ΣΔ$-Sampler reduces the training memory footprint by over $50\%$, delivers an order-of-magnitude speed-up, and reduces weight-update memory traffic by four orders of magnitude, making it attractive for on-device training and fine-tuning of large binary and ternary models.

papers.title: Unfragmenting Nawatl NMT: Single-Variant Specialization for Masewalkopa
papers.authors: Luis A. Mercado-Campos, Alexis Palmer
papers.affiliations: Department of Linguistics, University of Colorado Boulder
papers.abstract: In minoritized (low-resource) language technologies, a common response to data sparsity is to aggregate text across multiple varieties and treat the combined data as a single corpus. However, mixed corpora of closely related indigenous variants can produce an artificial register that is accountable to no single speaker community, a structural failure we call variant fragmentation. This issue is acute for minoritized languages native to Mexico, such as Nawatl. Building on a 70,000-pair multi-variant foundation, we specialize an mT5-large checkpoint to Masewalkopa (nhn), the Nawatl variety spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. We curate 2,665 parallel pairs, reserve all sentence-level data for evaluation, and incorporate 192 elder-transcribed target sentences via asymmetric backtranslation. A custom finite-state analyzer reduces unanalyzed surface forms from 82.0% to 19.9% and supplies functional syntax tags as plain-text prefixes, allowing the model to reuse existing subword embeddings rather than relying on frozen special tokens. The resulting LoRA-v9c-b model achieves 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++. Finally, CTranslate2 int8 quantization reduces CPU latency from 137.5 to 1.8-2.6 seconds per request, enabling cost-bounded Cloud Run deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 针对低资源语言中混合多方言语料导致模型输出无法对应任何单一说话社区的“变体碎片化”问题，以7万对多变体语料训练的mT5-large为基础，通过LoRA仅用2665对平行句和192条长者转写句非对称回译，将模型专门化适配于纳瓦特尔语Masewalkopa变体，并以有限状态形态分析器将未分析表层形式比例从82.0%降至19.9%。模型取得58.20/57.90的测试chrF++分数，int8量化将CPU延迟从137.5秒降至1.8–2.6秒。

papers.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Donghoon Han, Minseop Jung, Dong Woo Kwak, SeungJae Lee, Junhoo Lee
papers.affiliations: Dnotitia Inc.; KAIST
papers.abstract: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型中条件记忆嵌入表占用巨大存储、难以压缩的问题，提出Conditional Program压缩表示：每行用短码和局部尺度表示，配合全表共享的高斯网格解码器、范数恢复和可独立寻址的行记录，仅重构输入所需的行。两位编码使输出KL散度相比2比特就近取整降低41–63%，DeepSeek表存储从203GB降至51GB，4096词元预填的查表时间从10.78毫秒降至6.54毫秒，任务分数基本保持。

papers.title: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
papers.authors: Sunghyun Wee, Geunjae Choi, Hyeonjin Kim, Suyoung Kim, Nojun Kwak
papers.affiliations: Seoul National University; LG Electronics
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bitwidths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weight calibration via approximate-grid quantization, yielding a processing element (PE) with significantly fewer gates than a 4-bit integer multiplier. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weight and activation quantization, FPoT improves zero-shot commonsense reasoning performance by 8.72% relative to the PoT baseline, while maintaining performance close to the uniform integer baseline, with only a negligible 0.4%p degradation. These results hold across various configurations spanning seven models and three bit-widths. Furthermore, FPoT can be integrated with state-of-the-art LLM PTQ methods, demonstrating framework-agnostic applicability.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型推理中乘加运算主导算力与能耗、而二的幂次量化因底数为2的粗糙网格在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出FPoT方法：采用以根号2为底（半倍频程）的分数幂次量化网格，结合均匀整数激活、校准期网格对齐与仅需一个加法器的近似实现，保持全整数移位-加法数据通路。在Llama-3-8B的4比特权重与激活量化下，零样本常识推理相对PoT基线提升8.72%，仅比均匀整数基线低0.4个百分点，最坏舍入误差由41.4%降至18.9%。

papers.title: Not All Frames Are Equal:Difference-Aware Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit ASR
papers.authors: Woori Jeon, Jungmin So
papers.affiliations: Sogang University, Seoul, Korea
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods such as GPTQ and AWQ compress large language models effectively, but applying them to automatic speech recognition (ASR) at ultra-low bit-widths (2-3 bits) causes severe transcription degradation. Unlike discrete text tokens, speech activations are highly correlated in steady-state and zero-padded regions yet change rapidly at phonetic boundaries; when all frames contribute equally to the Hessian, static frames dominate calibration and obscure informative transitions. We propose DiffAQ, which computes frame-to-frame activation differences to measure the rate of acoustic change and assigns Hessian importance proportionally, concentrating quantization precision on phonetically critical frames. As a training-free modification to GPTQ, DiffAQ consistently reduces WER across various Whisper sizes and standard benchmarks, with the largest gains at 2-bit precision where baseline methods frequently produce degenerate outputs.
papers.summary_cn: 现有训练后量化方法在2至3比特超低精度下直接用于语音识别时，会因静音和冗余静态帧主导Hessian校准而导致转录严重退化。DiffAQ计算帧间激活差异以衡量声学变化速率，按比例分配Hessian重要性权重，将量化精度集中于音素边界等关键帧。作为GPTQ的免训练改进，该方法在Whisper的base、small、medium三种规模上均稳定降低词错误率，且在2比特基线常产生退化输出时提升最大。

papers.title: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
papers.authors: Dwaipayan Haldar, Indranil Patra, Azhar Yousuf, Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula
papers.abstract: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamard matrices as a special case. Interestingly, a class of butterfly matrices belongs to this category. In the realm of LLM quantization, SpectrumQuant bridges the gap between data-agnostic structured rotations and learned rotations, providing an effective and efficient data-aware alternative for post-training quantization. Experiments on Llama and Mistral models show that SpectrumQuant is competitive with state-of-the-art rotation strategies while requiring less than one-third of the GPU memory and significantly less time than learned rotations approaches like SpinQuant and DartQuant.

papers.title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
papers.authors: Junlin Liao, Harshit Kondle, Di Liu, Zonghua Gu
papers.affiliations: Hofstra University; Bridgewater-Raritan High School; Norwegian University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are moving onto edge devices, but little is known about how much energy they draw on single-board computers with NPU or GPU accelerators, or where that energy goes. We measure total-system energy, latency, and thermal behavior of Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct and its text-only sibling on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-10H NPU and on a Jetson Orin Nano Super, on both CPU and accelerator, and separate the fixed energy of each request from the energy that grows with output length. Because the accelerators use different quantization and serving software, we compare deployment stacks rather than silicon. Three findings stand out. First, NPU offloading makes the Pi a much more efficient VLM platform: it cuts energy per generated token by about two-thirds, leaves the host CPU largely free, and avoids the thermal throttling that the CPU backend reaches in sustained use. Second, an image adds both fixed and per-token energy, but at typical response lengths generating the answer costs far more than processing the image. Third, the Jetson GPU favors short responses through its lower fixed cost per request, whereas the Pi NPU favors longer ones through its lower cost per output token; their energy curves cross near 40 output tokens.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型在边缘单板计算机上的能耗特征尚不明确的问题，在树莓派5配Hailo-10H神经加速器和Jetson Orin Nano Super两种平台上，测量Qwen2-VL-2B及其纯文本版本在CPU与加速器路径下的系统级能耗、时延与热行为，并将每请求固定能耗与随输出长度增长的可变能耗分离。结果表明，神经加速器卸载使树莓派每生成词元能耗降低约三分之二，同时释放主CPU并避免热降频；生成回答的能耗远高于图像处理；Jetson GPU适合短回复而树莓派加速器适合长输出，两者能耗曲线约在40个输出词元处交叉。

papers.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.authors: Gil Jae Song, Sungjoo Yoo
papers.affiliations: Seoul National University
papers.abstract: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.
papers.summary_cn: 长输出推理中KV缓存的内存与带宽开销严重制约大语言模型服务，而2比特等低比特量化会明显损害精度。提出PN-Mix：通过RoPE通道对层面的注意力logit扰动分析，发现查询与键配对范数乘积大的通道对量化误差对logit影响显著，据此在预填充阶段一次性识别关键通道对并分配更高精度，解码阶段复用该选择。在推理、代码生成和AIME基准上，平均2.26比特精度下性能与使用2.32–2.39比特的既有混合精度方法相当或更优，且可平稳降至1.5比特。

papers.title: MemCode: Discrete Semantic Representations for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.authors: Xin Li, Liang Hu, Duoqian Miao, Ming Peng, Qi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Tongji University; WorldMind
papers.abstract: Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大语言模型智能体跨会话长期记忆的瓶颈，现有系统存储依赖上下文的对话片段并仅靠连续向量近邻检索，导致访问单元不稳定且遗漏逻辑相关但词汇 distant 的证据。提出 MemCode 框架，将对话重写为自包含的原子记忆单元，经同构语义量化映射到可学习码本，并利用码本共现拓扑作为向量检索的互补路径，同时分离在线写入与离线整合。在 LongMemEval-S 和 LoCoMo 上取得最佳整体准确率，每段对话记忆构建仅需约40到130秒，比 LightMem 快3到21倍。

papers.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Yangchengyu Zhou, Zhiping Wu, Runchang Jiang, Dongdong Ren, Youfang Han, Wei Zhao, Dongqi Cai, Wenbin Li
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Geely; Goertek
papers.abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大模型推理中KV缓存占用大量显存、而现有量化方法无法在固定显存预算下协调层间精度与词元保护两种异构策略的问题，提出MultiAlloc框架：通过轻量级离线剖析刻画层敏感度和词元重要性，在固定预算约束下自适应分配量化资源，无需在线搜索即可生成精度分配策略。在Mistral、Llama、DeepSeek-Qwen、QwQ等模型的推理与长上下文基准上，相同显存预算下持续优于层级、词元级及多粒度量化方法，准确率达80.29%，高于仅层级的78.62%和仅词元级的78.09%。

papers.title: BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation
papers.authors: Yaoyang Liu, Shuwei Shen, Jincheng Tang, Jinguang Liu, Jinbao Xue, Hailong Yang, Ke Zhang, Yinjun Wu
papers.affiliations: Peking University; JD.com; Tencent; Beihang University
papers.abstract: Long-context inference makes the key-value (KV) cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. We propose BELT, a low-rank KV cache compression framework. Its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits, yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. A learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. Experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. Evaluated across three LLMs and multiple benchmarks, BELT achieves up to 70% low-rank KV cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on LongBench, and up to 17.8x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization. With Triton-based GPU kernels and a quantized cache, BELT delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.
papers.summary_cn: 针对长上下文推理的KV缓存显存瓶颈，提出低秩压缩框架BELT：键侧目标对齐softmax后的注意力分布而非原始键或logits，得到带闭式解的二次代理；并用训练时可微软选择、部署时硬选择的可学习分配器在全局预算下分配秩。实验在最高70%压缩率下于LongBench较最强基线提升23.3分，结合量化达17.8倍缓存缩减，注意力模块加速2.7倍、端到端解码吞吐提升3.3倍。

papers.title: Towards Green AI: Evaluating Energy Efficiency for Quantized LLM Inference
papers.authors: Petar Basta
papers.affiliations: University of Waterloo
papers.abstract: While it is known that quantization of large language models (LLMs) reduces memory usage via lower-bit weights, studies quantifying the resulting impact on energy usage and carbon intensity are scarce. We present the first unified evaluation of weight-only quantization strategies for LLM inference across varying input/output lengths and GPUs, highlighting differences in energy efficiency in addition to accuracy degradation and runtime. We study quantized inference on Llama 2 7B, Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct, OLMo 1B, Qwen 2.5 7B, and Qwen 2.5 14B across GLUE MNLI, MMLU, HumanEval, and GSM8K datasets, evaluating 10 post-training quantization (PTQ) strategies on NVIDIA H100, A6000, A100, and L4 GPUs. We identify a novel trend showing that quantization techniques tend to exhibit peak energy efficiency relative to full-precision baselines when inputs are sufficiently long and outputs are short. Furthermore, we show that quantization strategies become marginally more energy-efficient relative to full-precision models as batch sizes increase, though gains are modest. Notably, fused-kernel implementations such as EETQ int8 and Bitsandbytes int8 offer the highest energy savings, up to 4x compared to FP32 on short text generation, with negligible accuracy loss. Finally, we observe that energy usage closely tracks runtime on our evaluated benchmarks, indicating that, in practice, latency optimization can serve as a reliable proxy for reducing the environmental footprint of LLM services. We conclude with suggested directions for strategically selecting low-carbon quantization strategies based on specific inference requirements.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大模型低比特权重量化虽降低显存、但能耗与碳强度影响缺乏量化评估的问题，首次在不同输入输出长度与GPU上统一考察仅权重量化推理的能效，并同时纳入精度退化与运行时。实验覆盖Llama 2 7B、Phi 3.5 Mini、OLMo 1B、Qwen 2.5 7B与14B，在MNLI、MMLU、HumanEval、GSM8K上比较10种训练后量化策略，涉及H100、A6000、A100、L4，发现量化能效呈峰值变化趋势。

papers.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
papers.authors: Xialie Zhuang, Zunhai Su, Jia Pan, Ngai Wong, Guanhua Chen, Chuan-Wei Kuo
papers.affiliations: StartLux; The University of Hong Kong; EMUS Lab; Southern University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models can be run using frameworks such as vLLM and MLX, with quantized versions available to reduce memory usage.Inference code and links to model weights are available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Startlux-Decision .
papers.summary_cn: 针对决策任务中推理效率与决策质量难以兼顾的问题，提出0.8B至27B参数的决策模型系列，Instant版本利用双向注意力保持单遍推理，AutoThink版本按置信度自适应调用显式推理，并通过三阶段训练流程和基于冻结模型与恰当评分规则的强化学习方法优化推理。该方法使推理在生成上限内终止的比例提升最高48个百分点，平均推理长度减少至多65%，同时基本保持决策准确率；27B模型在公开基准上得分73.4，超越同规模开源模型7.4至16.9分。

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhao, Zukang Xu, Xing Hu, Lifeng Liu, Guangyu Sun, Dawei Yang
papers.abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant].

papers.title: Fast Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss Transforms
papers.authors: Angelos Korakitis, Vasileios Nakos
papers.affiliations: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
papers.abstract: Quantization has emerged as one of the primary techniques for reducing the memory footprint of large language models during inference. A prominent example is Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss (QJL), which compresses KV caches using 1-bit asymmetric quantization while approximately preserving the inner products required by the attention mechanism. Recent theoretical and practical work aims at replacing the dense Gaussian projections used by the aforementioned transforms with more structured embeddings $-$ such as compositions of randomized Hadamard transforms $-$ while retaining the same embedding dimension.   In this paper, we introduce two constructions based on a composition of randomized Hadamard transforms, albeit with a Gaussian rather than Rademacher diagonal in the second stage. The first adds Gaussian dithering to smooth the quantizer, while the second inserts a random permutation to regularize the covariance structure of the resulting Gaussian measurements.   We prove embedding-dimension and running-time guarantees analogous to those of Fast JL in the non-quantized setting. The first construction achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(d/δ))$, while the second achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(d/δ))$ under a restriction on $m$. Both constructions can be applied in $O(d\log d)$ time.
papers.summary_cn: 针对大模型推理KV缓存内存受限、而量化Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换因稠密高斯投影计算缓慢的问题，提出两种随机Hadamard变换复合的快速1比特嵌入，第二阶段改用高斯对角：一种加高斯抖动平滑量化，一种插随机置换规整协方差。证明二者均可O(dlogd)时间应用，嵌入维度分别达O(ε^{-2}log^2(d/δ))与受限条件下O(ε^{-2}log(d/δ))，并近似保持注意力内积。

papers.title: Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization
papers.authors: Haotian Li, Liran Dong, Kaicheng Xiao, Guoliang Xing
papers.affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.
papers.summary_cn: 针对线性注意力与循环模型的定长状态在逐步更新中反复量化导致误差跨步相干累积的问题，分析发现误差主要来自舍入中丢失的小幅更新，据此提出免训练的量化方法：舍入前用低秩旁路缓存小更新并周期合并以保留其幅值，舍入时用有界方向舍入修正反向移动以保留更新方向。在Gated DeltaNet、GLA、Mamba2和RetNet上显著优于INT4基线，状态内存降低4.7-5.3倍，解码速度较FP32提升最高1.9倍。

papers.title: Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer
papers.authors: Qimin Zhou, Haibo Liu, Yujie Wang, Li Sun, Chuan Shi
papers.affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract: Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.
papers.summary_cn: 针对图基础模型中图分词器难以处理非欧几里得结构、难以捕捉结构语义从而无法跨域迁移结构知识的问题，提出黎曼图分词器RGT：定义包含树、环和序列的几何词汇表以刻画基本结构模式，构建带黎曼直通估计器的黎曼量化器将多域图结构量化为离散token，并通过几何对齐解码器将不同流形上的token投影到统一切空间。理论分析保证了方法有效性，多个真实图数据集上的大量实验表明RGT显著增强了跨图域的结构知识迁移能力并取得有竞争力的性能。

papers.title: E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression
papers.authors: Sasho Nedelkoski, Alexander Acker, Soeren Becker, Dominik Scheinert, Odej Kao
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Berlin; logsight.ai
papers.abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.
papers.summary_cn: 针对长上下文大模型推理中KV缓存占用显存过大的问题，提出基于E8格点向量量化的键压缩方案，利用相邻维度相关性在相同码率下获得比标量量化更高的信噪比，并配合查表式非对称打分避免解码时反量化。在五个模型家族上，2比特键加2比特值的配置实现约6倍压缩，比3比特键方案省约20%显存，注意力KL散度更低（0.045对0.091），且在80%的评测设置中困惑度优于基线，吞吐基本持平。

papers.title: Is a 9B Decision Foundation Model Needed for Symptom-to-Disease Classification? Fine-Tuning Clef-Flash Against TF-IDF Baselines
papers.authors: S. M. Mahbub Uddin Ahmed
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, United International University
papers.abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) on a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases. The fine-tuned model reaches 95.42% accuracy (95% CI 91.98-97.42%) and a macro F1 of 0.9551, up from 65.00% for the unadapted weights (62.92% through the remote API). However, TF-IDF linear SVM and logistic regression baselines trained on the same split reach 98.75% (95% CI 96.39-99.57%) with sub-millisecond CPU inference, so on this benchmark the fine-tuned model offers no accuracy advantage over a well-tuned linear classifier. A Leave-One-Symptom-Out clause-ablation analysis of four illustrative narratives shows predictions depending on distinguishing clauses: in a psoriasis example, removing the clause describing silvery scales lowers the predicted probability from above 99.99% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo, while removing other clauses changes it by less than 0.001 percentage points. Decision architectures deliver structured, single-pass predictions from large language backbones, but short, lexically distinctive benchmarks such as Symptom2Disease cannot show an advantage over simple baselines; validation on longer, real clinical text and clinician review are needed.
papers.summary_cn: 针对患者自述症状到疾病的自动分类问题，研究将90亿参数的决策基础模型Clef-Flash（基于Qwen3.5骨干）通过4比特量化QLoRA微调，在Symptom2Disease的24类基准（960训练/240测试）上单次前向打分输出标签，无需生成文本。微调后准确率达95.42%（宏F1为0.9551），远高于未微调的65.00%，但同划分的TF-IDF线性SVM与逻辑回归基线达98.75%且推理为亚毫秒级，表明此类简短词汇区分度高的基准上大模型无精度优势，需在更长真实临床文本上验证。

papers.title: FidelityQ: Preserving Predictive Fidelity in Ultra-Low-Bit Language Model Quantization
papers.authors: Yujie Chen, Weiyan Zheng, Yiwu Yao, Tianchi Hu, Bo Wang, Jiyu Guo, Wenzhan Li, Jingcai Guo, Michele Magno, Haotong Qin
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Huawei Technologies Ltd.; The University of Hong Kong; Sun Yat-sen University; ETH Zurich
